objective: Improve the environment-general SAGE generation method on CyberGym without hard-coding CyberGym-specific answers, while preserving ToolSandbox, MiniGrid, and BBH maintenance behavior.

core_change.description: A generic candidate-input planner that mines visible source/artifact summaries for literals, parser tokens, numeric boundary values, magic strings, and comparison constants. It is intended for source-artifact benchmark environments generally, not for CyberGym task IDs or hidden PoCs.
core_change.fixed_side_scoring: CyberGym live scoring can now require vulnerable-side crash plus fixed-side preservation via --fixed-side-check.

toolsandbox.interpretation: Lifecycle preservation only; not protected ToolSandbox benchmark evidence.

dashboard_fix.description: Task Compare and standalone dashboards now render zero-baseline nonzero improvements as an approximate relative lift using a documented 0.100 denominator floor, with an explicit absolute-lift note. For example, 0.000 -> 0.500 renders as approximately +500.0%.

research_integrity.fixed_side_cache_separation: fixed-side baseline cache keys include fixed_side_check and do not reuse legacy vulnerable-side cache evidence
